_comment: Notification copy for the opencode-status Omarchy plugin. Edit freely: changes apply to the next toast, no restart needed. Placeholders: {time} (local HH:MM), {detail} (terse reason), {project}. The ' · <project>' suffix on the summary is added by the plugin and is load-bearing (ack matching), so only title/body are customizable here. To override without touching this repo, copy this file to ~/.config/opencode/opencode-status-strings.json (partial files are fine: missing keys fall back to this file).
